study.question: Does training the added aligned field maps contribute to the observed AUC loss, and does holding those maps fixed allow 8-coordinate storage with 16-coordinate interactions to retain source click AUC at lower measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The compact aligned-map model remains below the unchanged source, while even a full-rank initially identity map loses AUC. A possible mechanism is that adapting the extra maps disturbs useful coordinate/gradient structure under the frozen single-pass optimizer. Freezing aligned maps may recover predictive quality without increasing storage or altering their forward computation. A 2x2 table-width (8/16) by map-trainability (frozen/learned) comparison separates the trainability intervention from raw storage rank. This is a falsifiable optimization/capacity diagnostic, not evidence of redundancy or a new architecture claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text, lines 219-279, describes embedding concatenation, target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and the dimension/storage burden. Inherit those basic components via the four-task source adaptation. This study concerns fixed versus trainable coordinate lifts after block compression; it is not an exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Read pinned source lines 55-160 and 160-200: per-field dimensions, sharing, padding and lookup behavior. Preserve FeatureEmbeddingDict and shared table objects. Added maps remain the preceding study implementation; freeze only map parameters and retain gradients to input embeddings.

Nearest actual compact implementation: identical [I8; I8] map initialization, trainable dense maps and source gradient routing. Sole executable change is a post-initialization requires_grad_(False) on the projection ModuleDict. Full-width g1-r0008-aligned16_interact16 supplies the corresponding identity-map control.

inherited_components: The full candidate and baseline modules were inspected. The stronger source is g2-r0004-context_only; baseline-din is the common initial reference.
All code, map initialization including the retained orthogonal RNG draws, compression, fields, masks, towers and gradient gates from g1-r0008-aligned8_interact16 / g1-r0008-aligned16_interact16.
Frozen host information, optimization, cost and validation contracts; no training-loss hook or new inputs.
study.proposed_difference: Freeze every added projection weight after the inherited aligned initialization; leave ordinary nn.Linear evaluation and BF16 autocast intact in both arms. Do not replace maps by identity/repeat shortcuts: doing so would also change autocast rounding and arithmetic. At width 8, compare frozen and learned duplication-initialized lifts; repeat at width 16 with identity-initialized maps. The learned cells are exact previous-source replays. Total registered parameters remain 16,166,277 and 32,065,317 respectively; expected trainable totals in frozen cells are 16,163,845 and 32,060,453, pending host alias/count verification.
predictions: At each storage width, learned and frozen cells have identical initialized state tensors and predictions under the same precision. Frozen map weights stay unchanged across an optimizer step while gradients still propagate into embeddings.

If map adaptation explains part of the full-width penalty, frozen16 click AUC will exceed learned16 (previously 0.6600539774138401) and approach unchanged-source 0.660646940486458. Recovery is diagnostic evidence only, because extra projection arithmetic remains relative to the source.

If the compact deficit is substantially caused by map adaptation, frozen8 will improve on learned8 (previously 0.6589788731410577). Its improvement relative to the width-16 contrast estimates an interaction, not a repetition.

Provisional efficiency screen: frozen8 click AUC >= 0.660146940486458 (source minus 0.0005), total parameters <= 60% of 32,060,453, and model-only p50 batch latency <= 95% of the unchanged-source reference with no p95 regression. This engineering margin is predeclared and is not a statistical noninferiority claim. Any apparent latency benefit requires a later contemporaneous unchanged-source comparison before robust efficiency claims.

Freeze alone should not improve inference latency within a width-matched pair: the forward operators are identical. Parameter/storage and cost improvements against source can arise from narrower tables, not from removing the few map gradients.
falsifiers: If frozen16 does not improve on learned16, the simple claim that map learning is responsible for its AUC loss lacks support; test residual precision/representation explanations separately rather than attributing failure to rank.

If frozen16 recovers but frozen8 remains below the retention screen, the tested fixed-lift compact model fails the efficiency objective. This points toward rank or tied-coordinate/gradient limitations but does not prove intrinsic rank necessity.
If frozen8 improves AUC but fails the source retention, parameter or measured latency criteria, report only a partial diagnostic improvement, not a successful quality-cost result.

Any initialized state/forward mismatch between matched learned/frozen cells, changing frozen weights, detached input gradients, altered Dice buffers, source-input leakage, missing validation samples or replay mismatch invalidates the intended attribution until corrected; failures and costs remain recorded.
alternative_explanations: One fixed seed and single pass: source retention and the trainability-by-width interaction are preliminary, with no significance claim.

Projection freezing changes the dense optimizer/clipping population and removes a few trainable parameters. Those are consequences of this intervention; it does not isolate a unique optimization submechanism.
A frozen 8-to-16 lift restricts effective representation rank; downstream fixed coordinate duplication also changes gradient geometry relative to a direct 8-wide model.
Inference wall time includes loading; model batch latency and throughput are distinct measurements and are subject to execution-order/cache noise.

The loss relative to the unprojected source may involve BF16 quantization introduced by nn.Linear, even with an identity matrix. This factorial holds that rounding path fixed within pairs and cannot remove that source-relative confound.

Coordinate duplication changes effective input covariance, gradient magnitudes and Adagrad trajectories. A frozen-map benefit need not imply that the original source has redundant embedding coordinates.
Auxiliary predictive quality is already substantially below the shared baseline in the inherited source. Improved click AUC must not be described as improvement across all four tasks.

evidence_review.scope: Only own-arm committed validation observations in allowed_observation_ids. No withheld outcomes accessed. No failed executions are listed in the supplied history; successful execution is distinct from failed scientific objectives.
trajectory_interpretation: Direct embedding and dense halving, and their joint cell, all lost click AUC relative to the stronger source. The embedding-half result is faster in model latency but is not quality retention.
Random-map factorial: table8/interact16 improved on direct8 but remained below source. The full-width random square-map control also lost AUC, showing that table rank was not isolated by that family.

Aligned initialization recovered 0.0017403852958787 AUC in the full-width map control but only 0.0001984096934542 in the compact map cell relative to their random-map replays. Compact aligned remains 0.0016680673454003 below source; full aligned remains 0.0005929630736179 below. These are one-seed observations, not established mechanisms.
Same-seed random-map replays reproduced their preceding AUCs exactly. They verify deterministic replay, not repeated support across random initializations.

Source mean-four-task AUC 0.6757994144720098 is much lower than baseline-din 0.8099233880793816. Click-selected results must report this auxiliary-task tradeoff; preserve all per-task AUC/Logloss in host receipts.

Their negative compact result does not test those external architectures. The present mechanism comes from that local deficit; the cards do not prescribe it.
